put.summary: Update prospect status and log to pipeline

post.summary: Clock In with face recognition and geofencing

400.description: Already clocked in or validation error

post.summary: Clock Out with optional face and location verification

400.description: Not clocked in or already clocked out

get.description: Returns whether the employee has a face enrolled and whether face verification is required for clock-in.

has_face_enrolled.description: Whether the employee has a face enrolled

requires_face_verification.description: Whether face verification is required at clock-in

post.description: Upload a clear photo of the employee's face. The system will extract a 128-dimensional face embedding and store it. This embedding is used to verify identity at clock-in. Only one face must be visible in the image.

requestBody.description: A clear photo of the employee's face (JPG/PNG, max 5MB). The face must be clearly visible and well-lit.

face_image.description: Face photo (JPG/PNG, max 5MB). Must contain exactly one clearly visible face.

422.description: No face detected in the uploaded image

message.example: No face detected in the image. Please upload a clear photo with a single visible face.

delete.description: Deletes the stored face encoding and face image for the employee, and disables face verification requirement at clock-in.
